name: popsicle
headline: SocialHub: Social Media & Order Management
short_description: Full-stack dashboard for managing social media interactions, orders, and webhooks with real-time Socket.IO updates and JWT-based access control.
author: Moajjem404

sections.overview:
SocialHub is a full-stack web application that centralizes management of social media interactions, e-commerce orders, and webhook integrations in a single dashboard. Built with Node.js, MongoDB, and Socket.IO, it delivers real-time notifications and updates across all social channels. The platform includes user management with ban/unban capabilities, complete order lifecycle tracking, and webhook automation that triggers n8n workflows or external services automatically. Teams use SocialHub to streamline customer engagement, track orders in real-time, and automate workflows across their tech stack. It features JWT authentication with role-based access control, mobile responsiveness, and comprehensive logging for compliance and auditing.
Manage comments, reactions, and orders from multiple social media channels in one dashboard
Automate workflows by triggering n8n jobs when orders are created or users interact with content
Ban or unban users with detailed logging and optional data cleanup
Monitor real-time notifications and updates across social media interactions using Socket.IO
- **Objective**: Increase brand awareness and drive website traffic
- **Duration**: 4 weeks
- **Target Audience**: Tech-savvy consumers aged 25-45
- **Platforms**: Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter
